why: Multiple post-snapshot papers prove specific cases of the Tate conjecture (abelian fourfolds over finite fields, surfaces of geometric genus one), and a September 2025 preprint claims a full proof for smooth projective varieties over finite fields.

found.title: The Tate conjecture for abelian fourfolds over finite fields
found.note: Preprint proving the conjecture for all abelian varieties of dimension four over finite fields; not read.

found.title: The Tate conjecture for surfaces of geometric genus one
found.note: Preprint largely completing the Kuga-Satake program for this case; not read.

found.title: A Constructive Spectral Proof of the Tate Conjecture for Smooth Projective Varieties over Finite Fields
found.note: Preprint claiming a full proof of the general conjecture; not read, unverified/unconventional venue.

found.title: On the integral Tate conjecture for abelian varieties
found.note: Paper on the integral (stronger) variant of the conjecture for abelian varieties; not read.
